string-array.name: onb_story
string-array.item: Working with a lot of businessmen, I noticed how they do [[personal branding]].
The one common thing they all do is, they share helpful tips about their service.
But there is a twist here. However good content you create, if you don\'t publish regularly and consistently, the social media algorithm will never show your posts to [[more audience]].
And these days, video content gets the most reach.
Now here is a thing. Which style of video can create the most trust?
See, videos made with AI and motion graphics look good. But when countless people are making videos in the exact same style, it has created a fatigue for the audience.
These days people want the [[human touch]].
People have lost so much trust watching AI content that, compared to a perfectly edited video, a real human walking around and making an average quality video with a phone creates [[more trust]].
And this is exactly what businessmen are doing now.
But after recording a video, some editing is needed. Also, to say the things in order in the video, you need to write a well planned script beforehand.
Again, for different platforms you need to edit videos in different shapes. So to do all this work every day, businessmen mainly hire three kinds of people.
1. A video editor, so that consistency is never missed.
2. A social media manager, to work on the social platforms regularly.
For the last three years I was thinking how to bring this [[cost]] down.
Then I developed a software system where you just open the app and start talking. [[Two-three minutes]] of talking, then close the app.
Now whatever work needs to be done, [[the app does all the rest]].
